title: Concept: Outbound request to a computed URL in python — review required
description: In python, a request is issued to a URL that an f-string, percent-format, concatenation, or a request field produced at the call site. If that value is attacker influenced, the request leaves the trust boundary on the attacker’s behalf and can reach loopback-only services, internal control planes, or cloud metadata credentials. The rule reports the shape of the argument, not its trust level, so every hit needs a human decision.
applicability: python services that fetch user-supplied resources, webhooks, images, or import URLs.
risk: Server-side request forgery into internal networks and metadata endpoints; HIGH severity.
